en.headline: Doctor cleared of misconduct over 2010 laser eye surgeries after 15 years
en.dek: The Medical Council offered no evidence against ophthalmologist Yiu Man-kit on three disciplinary charges linked to Lasik procedures and follow-up treatment.
body: An ophthalmologist was acquitted of professional misconduct on Wednesday after the Medical Council's secretary decided to offer no evidence on three disciplinary charges relating to laser eye surgery procedures performed in 2010.

Dr Yiu Man-kit faced allegations that he failed to properly explain risks and complications of recurrent corneal erosion before bilateral Lasik surgery in May 2010, did not give timely advice on post-surgery options, and inadequately performed a subsequent keratectomy on the right eye in September 2010. The complaint was lodged in 2011.

At the start of the inquiry, legal officer David Yim Ho-ching for the council's secretary indicated that no evidence would be offered. Inquiry panel chairwoman Professor Grace Tang Wai-king recorded the acquittal, noting that the burden of proof rested with the secretary.

zh.headline: 眼科醫生涉2010年激光手術專業失德指控不成立
zh.dek: 醫務委員會秘書未有就三項紀律指控提證，眼科醫生姚文傑在事隔15年後獲裁定專業失德不成立。
body: 一名眼科醫生星期三在醫務委員會研訊中，因委員會秘書決定不就三項紀律指控提證，獲裁定專業失德不成立。
姚文傑醫生被指於2010年5月進行雙眼激光矯視手術前，未有妥善解釋復發性角膜上皮糜爛的風險及併發症；手術後未有及時提供適當建議；以及於同年9月為右眼進行角膜切除術時處理不當。有關投訴於2011年提出。
研訊開始時，代表委員會秘書的法律人員嚴浩正表示不會提證。研訊小組主席鄧惠琼教授記錄了不成立裁決，並指出舉證責任在於秘書一方。
